notes.title: Scramble: Battle of Britain – Pilots & Squadron Update
notes.notes: [p]Back in December last year, we launched our Squadron Leader Game Mode, which lets players step into the shoes of a WWII leader and manage a squadron through a 30-day single-player campaign, learning how to combine different pilot traits, when to send people on leave, and how to rebuild a balanced crew after casualties.[/p][p]Squadron Leader quickly became one of the most played and appreciated parts of our Early Access journey, and ever since, we’ve been thinking about how to take it to the next level.[/p][p]Today, with the [b]Pilots & Squadron Update[/b], we’re expanding on that foundation, adding deeper improvements to both the squadron and pilot layers.[/p][h2]What’s New in the Pilots & Squadron Update?[/h2][p]We’ve introduced a number of systems and mechanics that shape how pilots behave, grow, and impact your squadron:[/p][list][*][p]Newly created squadrons will be populated with pilots of varying experience levels and sortie counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot traits improve and worsen according to each pilot’s experience, readiness, and morale. [/p][/*][*][p]Every pilot now has experience, readiness, and morale states that adjust according to individual and squadron performance.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Veteran pilots will see improved leadership abilities, while inexperienced pilots will struggle in leadership roles.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilots will become rusty without regular combat sorties.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot and squadron morale will fluctuate in coordination with success and failure.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pilot wellness states (like Rusty or Veteran) generate positive or negative modifier traits.[/p][/*][*][p]Traits influence base performance and can be improved or worsened over time.[/p][/*][*][p]A “Sortie History” interactive calendar tracks the results of every mission flown with detailed statistics and match replay files.[/p][/*][/list][p]The Pilots & Squadron update deepens strategic decisionmaking in the Squadron Leader game mode, and the new mechanics will help players tell a more rich and emotional story of each squadron. Pilot Trait modifications are another important building block for our in-development Channel Defense Campaign. We will continue adding new pilot traits and trait modifications in each update on our road to leaving Early Access.In addition to Squadron Leader mechanics, this update is packed with improvements to Scramble VFX and bug fixes. As usual, you can find the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1530450/discussions/0/601900367173707469/"]full changelog history here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Download Scramble: Battle of Britain Now[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530450/Scramble_Battle_of_Britain/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Squadron Leader Update - v.010.004
notes.notes:
Tally ho, pilots!

Exciting news is on the horizon! We're gearing up to open a [b]new beta branch[/b] exclusively for Early Access users, giving you the opportunity to playtest upcoming content in development—stay tuned!

In the meantime, we've just released a [b]major update[/b] packed with enhancements to the [b]Squadron Leader experience[/b], including improved balance, new Leadership Traits, and detailed progress reports.
This update also features a host of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

Read more details in the full changelog below:

[h2]Squadron Leader Update 1
v.010.004 - Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Enhancements[/h3]

[b]Squadron Leader[/b]

[list]
[*] Every pilot is generated with one Leadership trait (upon Start New Squadron)
[*] Leadership traits impact a leader's whole section on a per-mission basis
[*] New After Action Report is presented to the player after every mission
[*] New Squadron Summary Report is available to the player to track the progress of their SQL squadron
[*] Gamepad support added to all SQL menus
[*] Pilot traits color in Section Assignment to help discern between pilots
[*] Confirmation prompt added to "Start New Squadron" method
[*] SQL long-form game balanced to be less punishing
[*] SQL scenario generation is more intentional, and informed by leadership traits
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

[list]
[*] Button/Input glyphs updated and customized for popular gamepads
[*] VFX visual enhancements
[*] How to Play section renders currently assigned input glyphs
[*] Option added to constrain mouse pointer to game window
[*] Increased pool of Luftwaffe pilot names
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Dogfight[/b]

[list]
[*] Aircraft physics fixed for planes flying straight & level (notable for Stukas and fighters in Level Flight mode)
[*] Pilots and cockpit art of dead/escaped aircraft should no longer hang in sky
[*] Aircraft Health/Status panel fixes for some aircraft
[*] Damage & Debris art fixes for all aircraft
[*] Pilot Actions semi-circle menu no longer locks open
[*] Stukas now fly in a single formation
[*] Match score bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Squadron Leader[/b]

[list]
[*] Section animation at Scramble fixed
[*] Pilot duplication fixed
[*] SQL save data integrity improved
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

[list]
[*] Typos fixed in pilot traits
[*] “Controls Not Modified" no longer appears in match opening screen
[*] Improved support for wide monitor resolutions
[*] VSync fixes
[/list]
